machine: Linux x86_64, Node 24, headless Chromium, ORT 1.31.1 WASM CPU (no WebGPU adapter in this environment)
notes: OCR numbers are one warmed run of the shipped tiny_det+small_rec pipeline on CPU WASM; no WebGPU adapter was available, so WebGPU numbers are not claimed.
Translation numbers use a deterministic fake engine with one macrotask per delta; they measure reader plumbing and first painted cover, not real model decoding.
Raw CPU inference is unchanged; speed work is page OCR caching, one idle-time prefetch, progressive per-block painting and a WebGPU EP path with WASM fallback.
Screenshots live in bench/results/image-paper/after-p1.png and after-p2.png; /opt/cursor/artifacts is read-only in this sandbox.
